description: The test file's header comment (line 1) states the test exercises 'real DDG + Jina network calls', but the code under test performs HN Algolia + Jina (no DuckDuckGo). The stale documentation masks the spec-vs-impl divergence flagged in FIND-001 and would mislead a future maintainer or a Phase-6 convergence reader into believing the DDG requirement (R1) is exercised when it is not. Spec, impl header (lines 3-5), and test comment disagree on the actual data source.
